text:
Type: ladder bookcase
Use: storing books and decor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, minimalist, classic
Materials: solid rubber wood in an espresso finish
Colors: dark warm espresso brown
Shape: tall narrow leaning-style frame with angled side rails, five open shelves widening toward the bottom, no back, light and open
Feel: tidy, warm, simple
Goes with: cream walls, light floors, neutral textiles; traditional or contemporary rooms

product.name: AmazonBasics Classic 5-Shelf Open Bookcase Organizer with Solid Rubber Wood Frame - Espresso
product.description: 5-tier classic ladder-style bookcase for placing keepsakes, decor, books, awards, and more Descending design with shelf widths widening at the bottom Straight back allows you to place bookcase neatly against a wall; angled front saves space Solid rubber wood construction; each shelf holds 25 pounds Minimal, modern design complements a variety of interior aesthetics Easy to assemble with provided instructions and hardware
